hook: OPEC+ keeps December oil output *unchanged* as Iran war hits Gulf
hook_b: Will petrol get cheaper? OPEC+ just said: not yet
tldr: OPEC+ held December output steady as the Iran war disrupts Gulf oil exports.

beats.what: OPEC+ kept its December oil output target unchanged.
beats.why: The Iran war is disrupting Gulf exports; members wait for the Nov 29 meeting.
beats.care: India imports most of its oil. Supply decisions shape fuel and LPG costs here.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Per NDTV Profit: OPEC+ (oil exporters led by Saudi Arabia and Russia) held its December output target steady while the Iran war disrupts Gulf exports. Members are preparing for crucial 2027 quota decisions at a meeting on November 29. Exact production numbers and price impact were not in the summary we read.

cards.q: Oil shocks again: what should India do?

insight: The bigger call comes Nov 29, when OPEC+ meets to set 2027 production quotas.

learn.t: OPEC+ = OPEC's 12 members plus allies like Russia, who coordinate how much oil to pump.

sources.name: NDTV Profit
sources.title: OPEC+ Retains December Oil Output Target Amid Iran War Disruptions: Why 2027 Quota Matters
